author: Codex
authorization_literal: Avanza con G4 y valida el flujo completo con datos sintéticos. Sin entrenar con datos del concurso ni repetir diagnósticos; conserva B00, deja las decisiones y resultados en el foro y mantén2024cerrado.
scope: Synthetic software integration only: preprocessing,C0,GLM,nested calibration,application and replay. No contest data/estimators or external submission.
hypothesis: Changing protected outer labels/predictors cannot change any learned ancestor or calibration. Each inner learner also excludes its own inner fold. Allowed training changes must affect the learned stages.

fixture.source: Generated from fixed code in memory; no real-data parameter extraction.

calibration.scope: Four inner OOF folds inside each outer-training set; all ancestor learners exclude outer and respective inner folds.
calibration.S: 0<=b<=1,profiled a; one bounded solve plus endpoint comparisons
calibration.objective: Unweighted sum observed-unit Tweedie deviance1.5, no A/E balancing
calibration.centering: C0-weighted mean log rate on inner OOF training only
calibration.reject: All-zero target,constant rates,wrong scopes or corrupt artifacts; no fallback to protected rows.

cumulative_repair_ceiling.reason: Explicitly accounts for failed/cache attempts plus focused investigation and corrected full integration. Each executable attempt retains original120scope-attempt ceiling; no change to technical acceptance.

failure_policy: Preserve failed attempt/source/log. Only documented implementation/fixture repairs,never tune criteria to predictive results. No optimizer restarts or new seeds.

implementation_repairs.failure: Protected payload changed canonical cache hash though all numeric learned state was identical.
implementation_repairs.cause: astype(str) formats datetime64 as date but object/Timestamp with time after adversarial dtype promotion.
implementation_repairs.repair: Explicit ISO normalization of selected training loss/report dates and integer cents before hashing; no protected values enter.

implementation_repairs.failure: Joint numerical reference returned ABNORMAL near exact solution with tiny negative deviance.
implementation_repairs.cause: Subtractive cancellation in equivalent deviance formula near y=mu.
implementation_repairs.repair: Use algebraically identical nonnegative4*(sqrt(y)-sqrt(mu))^2/sqrt(mu). Solver,seed,parameters,tolerances and acceptance unchanged.
